source.excerpt: Shared as a car search that brings the shortlist to your inbox instead of the lot.

body:
## What it does

Point it at a ZIP code and say whether you want a Model 3, Model Y, Model X or Model S, and it searches US used listings for cars that fit. What it finds lands in your inbox as a plain list, with the dealer gloss scraped off so the cars can be compared fairly. It looks and reports; nothing is bought.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @cicerougc shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
